$note: Keys the code already asked for and no catalogue ever defined. Every one of them is a composed-key family or a call site that reached the missing-translation handler in production: the handler humanised the last segment, so a Spanish screen printed 'Started', 'Load roles' or 'Past due' and nothing failed. They are added here as part of the migration and, from now on, verify-catalogues.mjs fails the build on a referenced key with no entry.
